scope: Authorized EDA block-C regularized linear residual diagnostic only; not a DL benchmark.

reference.objective: sum((y-intercept-Z beta)^2) + alpha sum(beta^2); no 1/N factor; intercept not penalized
reference.implementation: SciPy Cholesky; training-only NumPy mean and population standard deviation; sklearn not installed or used
reference.input_order: oldest day first; within each day open, high, low, close, volume
reference.feature_transform: raw OHLCV flattened then standardized; no target transform
reference.target: sigma_7 on outcome day, unscaled daily log-return units
reference.negative_predictions: retained and counted; no clipping or postprocessing
reference.training_schedule: one fixed 2023 fit per D; no refit using 2024 labels
reference.selection: all four agreed D reported; alpha fixed without tuning; no D ranking or winner selection
reference.randomness: deterministic closed-form solve; no training random seed required
reference.fitting_policy_scope: diagnostic only; does not fix the retraining policy, alpha or implementation of the later DL benchmark

diagnostics.acf_estimator: demeaned biased autocovariance ratio, statsmodels acf adjusted=False
diagnostics.acf_band: zero-centred pointwise approximate 95% white-noise reference ±1.96/sqrt(366); not simultaneous or robust to arbitrary dependence
diagnostics.model_df_reason: out-of-training residuals of a model fixed on 2023; no ARMA order estimated on these validation errors
diagnostics.pvalue_reference: asymptotic chi-square diagnostic; no exact finite-sample or arbitrary-nonstationarity claim
diagnostics.multiplicity: Holm over all 12 tests across four D and three lags; does not repair misspecification of the reference distribution
diagnostics.stable_tail_reporting: log chi-square tails and log-Holm retained; <1e-300 is an asymptotic-reference inequality, never an exact probability zero

meaningful_checks: training indices reconstructed and matched to first-origin CV hash
all training labels and covariates precede the validation origin and respect embargo
scalers fitted only to the allowed 2023 samples
Ridge predictions reproduced by independent augmented least squares
ACF and Ljung-Box Q checked independently
stable chi-square tails and Holm verified against library fixtures
limitations: The target is a rolling seven-return standard deviation; adjacent outcomes share six returns.
Residual autocorrelation can reflect overlapping targets, a limited linear reference, misspecification or regime changes.
Residual dependence alone does not establish that adding target lags is necessary or sufficient, nor automatically change the current type-4 input contract.
ACF bands and Ljung-Box references are exploratory approximations; Holm controls multiplicity only under the relevant reference validity.
These four static diagnostic models are not the three DL baselines, not a performance benchmark and not a frozen E2 protocol.
2024 is development validation; no test period is opened or evaluated.
